verdict.rationale: Qdrant's self-hosted deployment model (Docker volumes, on-prem/K8s options) implies users fully own and can delete their storage, and snapshot/backup features give some control over data lifecycle, but the evidence pack has no explicit documentation of a delete-collection/delete-point API, TTL/retention policies, or data-expiry controls tailored to privacy compliance. missing for 10: explicit deletion/point-removal API docs, retention/TTL policy documentation, GDPR-style data-erasure guidance.
